A beautiful story brought to life by our little stars! 🌸💫

Through this special skit, our children beautifully portray the story of Lord Ganesha, Goddess Parvati, Lord Shiva, and the divine transformation that made Ganesha the beloved elephant-headed God. 🐘❤️
